name: Porto, Portugal
author: bquelhas
description:
**Porto Metropolitan Area (AMP)** — 17 municipalities, 1.7M inhabitants.

(Vibecoded with Claude )

## Demand Model
- 59,992 O/D pairs generated from **INE BGRI 2021** (census tract level)
- **1.20M simulated passengers** — 70.6% population coverage
- Realistic urban drive-times (20/30/60 km/h by zone + 20% congestion penalty)
- Captive boost for low car-ownership areas (Porto ×1.8, Gaia ×1.6, Matosinhos ×1.35)

## Points of Interest
- Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport, Port of Leixões, Cruise Terminal
- Major hospitals (São João, Santo António, Pedro Hispano) and universities (UP, FEUP, ISEP)
- CP rail stations (Campanhã, São Bento, Devesas) and bus terminals
- 30+ tourist POIs: Ribeira, Torre dos Clérigos, Serralves, Casa da Música, Port Wine Caves

## Coverage
- Full detail up to zoom 15 across the AMP
- Northern Portugal at low zoom (Braga, Aveiro, Viana do Castelo, Bragança) for geographic context
